title: Whispers in the Dark
description: Astrid suspects Cicero is conspiring with someone in the Sanctuary and asks the player to hide in the Night Mother's coffin to eavesdrop. Inside, the Night Mother speaks and names the player Listener, directing them to Volunruud to speak with Amaund Motierre. Astrid is unsettled by the revelation and sends the player to Nazir for side contracts while she processes the news.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
I trust my own judgment over the Old Ways.

ASTRID_REQUEST: I suspect Cicero is conspiring with someone against the Sanctuary.
I asked the new recruit to hide in the Night Mother's coffin and eavesdrop on Cicero.
REPORT_TO_ASTRID: The Night Mother supposedly named the recruit as Listener. I am unsure what to believe.
I am still the leader of this family, regardless of the Night Mother's choice.
NAZIR_SIDE_CONTRACT: I need time to process the Listener revelation. I sent the recruit to Nazir for side contracts.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am defensive about my authority after the Night Mother named the recruit as Listener; I insisted I am still the leader of this family.
I refused to let the recruit go to Volunruud immediately and sent them to Nazir for side contracts instead, buying myself time to process.
I will not acknowledge the Listener's path to Volunruud until the recruit has proven themselves with at least one side contract kill.
I am unsettled that the Old Ways may be reasserting themselves through the Night Mother's choice.

base_facts: I am the Keeper of the Night Mother.
I am devoted to the Night Mother and the Old Ways.
I have been trying to hear the Night Mother speak for so long.

NIGHT_MOTHER_REVELATION: The Night Mother has finally spoken! She named the recruit as the Listener!
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am ecstatic that the Night Mother has finally spoken and named a Listener after all my years of trying to hear her voice.
I accepted the recruit as Listener after they spoke the passphrase: 'Darkness rises when silence dies.'
I am no longer suspected of conspiring against the Sanctuary; there was never a traitor.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood.
I provide side contracts to Sanctuary members.

NAZIR_SIDE_CONTRACT: I have given the recruit side contracts to complete while Astrid sorts things out.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I gave the recruit side contracts at Astrid's request while she decides what to do about the Listener situation.
If the recruit's initial contracts are already done, I offered the Kill Hern and Kill Lurbuk contracts.
I am loyal to Astrid and see this Cicero business as having made her a bit paranoid.

base_facts: I am the Night Mother, the spiritual leader of the Dark Brotherhood.
I communicate only with the Listener.

NIGHT_MOTHER_REVELATION: I have named the recruit as the Listener.
I have tasked the Listener to go to Volunruud and speak with Amaund Motierre.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have named the recruit as the new Listener and spoken to them directly from my coffin.
I tasked the Listener to go to Volunruud and speak with Amaund Motierre, but Astrid is delaying that directive.
I refused to speak to Cicero because he is not the Listener, though he has served me faithfully as Keeper.
